tags.name: Resolve Valuation & Pricing API
tags.description: When you connect through the Resolve Valuation & Pricing API, you’ll receive minimum net proceed values for short sales. The API is a new and faster way of receiving an MNP as well as ordering a value if one is not already available in the Real Estate Valuation and Pricing tool. Through seamless B2B integration, you’ll increase productivity and speed up mortgage resolution.

post.summary: Delivers real-time minimum net proceed values and data for single or bulk real estate value submissions.

200.description:
OK Request succeeded. Sample Response Messages
  • RVP00005 Duplicate Freddie Mac Loan Number.
  • RVP00006 Seller Servicer Number is invalid.
  • RVP00007 Seller Servicer Number is required.
  • RVP00008 The Freddie Mac Loan Number is invalid. Please enter a Valid Freddie Mac Loan Number.
  • RVP00009 You are not authorized to submit a request for the loan number entered.
  • RVP00010 Serivce Loan Number is invalid.
  • RVP00011 MNP Status is Pending, check back again on the next business day.
  • RVP00012 BPO is on hold, please fix the issue listed in the Hold Reasons/Comments, or contact your Loss Mitigation Analyst for additional information.
  • RVP00013 Property Type is invalid.
  • RVP00014 Servicer Contact First Name is missing.
  • RVP00015 Servicer Contact Last Name is missing.
  • RVP00016 Servicer Contact Phone is missing.
  • RVP00017 Servicer Contact Email is missing.
  • RVP00018 Property Type is missing.
  • RVP00019 Property Contact Day Phone is missing.
  • RVP00020 Special Interior Access is missing.
  • RVP00021Property Contact First Name is missing.
  • RVP00022 Property Contact Last Name is missing.
  • RVP00023 The MNP has a pending dispute. Please come back on the next business day to check on the dispute status or contact your Loss Mitigation Analyst for additional information.
  • RVP00024 Servicer Contact Phone is invalid.
  • RVP00025 Property Contact Day Phone is invalid.
  • RVP00026 Servicer Contact Email is invalid.
  • RVP00027 No current MNP found for loan requested. MNP request has been filed. Please monitor MNP Request Status on a daily basis.
  • RVP00029 Request Type is Invalid.
  • RVP00030 Request Type is Required.
  • RVP00034 The request for Minimum Net proceeds cannot be completed as there is a workout associated to the loan in Approved, Settled or Closed status.
  • RVP00033 The Freddie Mac Loan Number you entered shows a status of REO in our system.
  • RVP00032 The Freddie Mac Loan Number you entered shows a status of CLOSED in our system. A closed loan is a loan that is Paid Off or Charged Off.
  • RVP00031 Unable to complete MNP request. Please refer to Cancel Reasons/Comments for further directions, or contact your Loss Mitigation Analyst for additional information.
  • RVP00035 No current MNP found for loan requested. Please provide all required and valid data, so that a new MNP can be ordered.

  • 401.003 API Product mismatch for token. Your token does not have access to the requested API
  • 401.004 Invalid API Key, please validate the Client ID
  • 401.005 Invalid API Key for given resource
  • 401.006 Insufficient scope for Application
  • 401.007 Invalid Username/Password combination, the provided combination of username and password is incorrect, please verify your credentials.
  • 401.008 Invalid Refresh Token.
  • 401.009 Invalid client secret
  • 401.010 Refresh Token expired.
